# Jarrod Tran

Jarrod Tran is Head of Strategic Planning and Special Projects for Tesla Energy Megapack in Houston, Texas.

He works on capacity planning, cost, special projects, and how factories use AI on the floor. He is an operator, not a research scientist or ML engineer.

Previously: Apple (Senior Strategic Operations Program Manager, iPhone manufacturing in India), Waymo (Strategy & BizOps Manager, Engineering), Tesla Special Projects (4680 and Fremont vehicle operations), Amazon (Operations Area Manager).

Selected outcomes:
- Tesla Energy: 3.2× production scale (14.7 to 46.7 GWh), $260M annualized savings, $156M incremental annual profit from a $23M capacity portfolio.
- Apple iPhone India: 293% year-over-year unit growth (4.3M to 16.9M), revenue $2B to $10B, exports from 6 to 40+ countries.

Education: B.S. Business Administration, Finance, University at Buffalo, Cum Laude.
